mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipes ( user_id, recipe_name, servings, category_id, source_type, source_url, memo, is_favorite, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recipeName}, #{servings}, #{categoryId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{memo}, COALESCE(#{isFavorite}, false), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.recipe_name AS recipeName, r.servings, r.category_id AS categoryId, rc.name AS categoryName, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_url AS sourceUrl, r.memo, r.is_favorite AS isFavorite, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.recipe_name AS recipeName, r.servings, r.category_id AS categoryId, rc.name AS categoryName, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_url AS sourceUrl, r.memo, r.is_favorite AS isFavorite, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.recipe_name AS recipeName, r.servings, r.category_id AS categoryId, rc.name AS categoryName, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_url AS sourceUrl, r.memo, r.is_favorite AS isFavorite, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recipes SET recipe_name = #{recipeName}, servings = #{servings}, category_id = #{categoryId}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipes WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
